scenarios.when: the active host cannot be identified as Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, or Trae
scenarios.then: ask the user which supported host they use and do not modify files

scenarios.when: no local terminal, PowerShell, exec, or shell execution is available
scenarios.then: state that automatic local upgrade cannot run and provide the native official copyable command for the identified host; do not claim success

scenarios.when: an existing older official Skill installation has no native platform installer
scenarios.then: download the matching official Shell or PowerShell installer into a new private temporary directory and execute that local file. Do not pipe remote content into a shell, use Node, npm, Git, or install dependencies.

scenarios.when: the native platform installer cannot download or statically validate the official main source before sync
scenarios.then: report the validation failure and stop before changing installed Skills. Do not install Node, npm packages, Git, generators, docs sync, formatters, repair commands, Git writes, or any other source-mutating command to make the official source pass.

scenarios.when: a current or retired target directory is missing the matching managed Skill markers
scenarios.then: report the exact conflict and stop before changing any target directory; do not overwrite, delete, rename, or merge it

scenarios.when: a verified retired managed Skill directory or an older hidden retired backup is present in the target root
scenarios.then: after all current official Skills install or upgrade successfully, delete that verified retired directory so the host cannot continue discovering it; never delete an unmanaged directory

scenarios.when: a supported host has no conflicting target directories
scenarios.then: run the official sync command once, report every installed or upgraded Skill and the synchronized official version, then tell the user to start a new host conversation
